summary: Backend-only security P0 hardening verification executed against public preview URL with auth regression + playbook checks.

critical.issue: Missing identifier / fully empty credentials return 400 ("المعرّف مطلوب") instead of required fail-closed 401.
Credentialed CORS contract failing on live response: Access-Control-Allow-Origin is '*' and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials header is absent.

action_items: Normalize auth fail-closed behavior so empty/missing login payloads return 401 consistently.
Fix live CORS credential headers for auth endpoints (explicit origin + Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; no wildcard when cookies are used).
Update /app/memory/test_credentials.md to include the documented security test password reference requested by this story (without exposing production secrets).
critical_code_review_comments: Verified code no longer seeds MANAGER_QUICK_PIN or calls auth_store.ensure_pin at startup.
Verified freeze-scope files remain unchanged in working tree: accounting_engine.py, routes_finance.py, JournalEntries.jsx, vehicle_finalization_posting.py.
Auth test stability issue fixed in regression test by generating unique IPs to avoid historical lockout contamination between reruns.
seed_data_creation: No financial/business seed data mutated. Security user auth credential setup used only for auth test path.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Baseline hardening tests pass (name-only blocked, default PIN blocked, valid employee role, finance-action 403, lockout 429, secret-key non-leak checks). Remaining blockers are status-code contract for empty identifier and live credentialed CORS header mismatch.
rca of the issue: RCA-1: /api/auth/login currently raises HTTPException(400, "المعرّف مطلوب") before fail-closed 401 credential checks, causing contract mismatch for empty identifier cases. Repro: POST {} to /api/auth/login => 400. RCA-2: backend app code sets credentialed CORS, but live preview response headers show wildcard ACAO and missing Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, likely due edge/proxy CORS override; this breaks strict cookie-based cross-origin auth contract.
